subject: c10-math
note: Marks are official and given per unit (theory total 80, internal assessment 20: pen-paper test and multiple assessment 5+5, portfolio 5, lab practical 5). Question mix: remembering and understanding 43 marks (54%), applying 19 (24%), analysing, evaluating and creating 18 (22%).
mistakes: Algebra is 20 of 80 marks. Practise quadratic equations and arithmetic progressions regularly and check your roots by substituting them back.
Show every step of your working so that you can earn method marks even if the final answer is wrong.
Coordinate geometry: be careful when substituting values into the distance and section formulas, especially signs.
Heights and distances: draw a clear figure and mark the angle of elevation or depression correctly before you calculate.
Mensuration: check whether the question asks for curved surface area, total surface area or volume, and give the correct unit.
Statistics: write the class intervals and the table clearly before applying the formula for mean, median or mode.
order: Algebra first (Ch 2 to 5, 20 marks): the largest unit, and Chapters 3 and 4 build on each other.
Then Statistics and Probability (Ch 14 and 15, 11 marks) and Mensuration (Ch 12 and 13, 10 marks).
Finish with Number Systems and Coordinate Geometry (6 marks each), which are shorter.
Keep portfolio and lab activities (10 internal marks) on schedule with your school.
